name: Multiple Time Clock (MTC)
description: Displays multiple clocks for different time zones.
project_description:
Multiple Timezone Clock module provides a block and an admin config. In admin config having multiple clocks settings for different timezone. This module does not depend on any external javascript library or PHP library.

 The time clock has 5 skins to choose from.

 CONFIGURATION 

 
 Install the module "Multiple Timezone Clock". 
 Admin config Url:- admin/config/multiple_timezone_clock 
 Fill value under the select cock country fieldset and click to "Add one more" for adding more clocks settings. 
 Go to the “Block Layout”. Eg:- Admin Menu >> structure >> block layout 
 Go to your block region where you want to put it. 
 Click the "Place block" button and in the modal dialog click the "Place block" button next to "Multiple Timezone Clock". 
 Click on the Save block button. 
 
 Install it like any other module 
 composer require drupal/mtc
